about: Prince George is at the confluence of the Fraser and Nechako rivers in north-central British Columbia. It is the main service, forestry, and university city of the northern Interior, a highway and rail junction toward Prince Rupert, Dawson Creek, and the south. Winters are cold; the surrounding landscape is forest and plateau. About 77,000 people live in Prince George.
